individual_run_test_results.prompt: How can I preview backlink changes without applying them using dryRun?
individual_run_test_results.agent_output:
To preview backlink changes without applying them, you can use the dryRun option set to true. This option allows you to see what changes would be made without actually modifying any notes.

For example, if you are using the auto_backlink_vault function, you can call it like this:

```json
{
  "dryRun": true
}
```

This will generate a preview of backlink changes across your vault without applying them. You can review the output to understand what backlinks would be added or modified.
